# Rubber duck this

Run `rubber-duck-gate` against the current plan or implementation. Supply the problem, chosen
design, rejected alternative, and assumptions, then ask the selected independent reviewer to tell
you what breaks. The skill is the single source for reviewer selection, severity handling, and
evidence recording; do not duplicate it here.
